scope: Native Scrape Video Copy readiness in tests/browser/scrape-native-media-actions.mjs

source_run.observation: Video was selected and rendered as Video 2 with two rows and Copy controls. Readiness returned selected=false, rowCount=1, targetCount=1. No Copy pointer action occurred. Links controls were never reached.

confirmed_cause: The readiness helper compared the selected trigger's full textContent to Video. ScrapeTab renders a count span after its label when count > 0, so the selected trigger's textContent was Video2. Other native Scrape observers already identify tab labels using firstChild.textContent.
repair: Read only the selected trigger's label text node for readiness; retain the selected aria state, exact href row, and unique Copy target requirements.

regression_guard.case: selected Video with a rendered count badge is ready only for its unique Copy row
regression_guard.green_after_repair: 22 tests passed with a selected Video 2 trigger and the exact Copy row; the same fixture rejects readiness when Images is selected while the Video row remains in the DOM.

native_acceptance: Not rerun in this lane; T12 Copy and later actions, T13 Links, and remaining acceptance cases are unverified.
